articles.title: Company Overview
articles.markdown:
# Company

**Harbor Logistics** runs regional last-mile delivery for retailers. Support covers shipment exceptions, driver apps, and billing disputes.

articles.title: Delivery Exception Policy
articles.markdown:
# Exceptions

Failed delivery: two reattempts within 48 hours, then hold at depot for 5 days. After hold expiry, return-to-sender is automatic. Address changes are allowed only before first out-for-delivery scan.

articles.title: SLA Credits
articles.markdown:
# SLA

If a guaranteed window is missed by more than 4 hours and Harbor caused the delay, issue a 15% delivery-fee credit. Weather holds and customer-not-available events are excluded.
